subscription_products.product_name: Royal Canin Size Health Nutrition Small Puppy Dry Dog Food, 14-lb bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: AJ is a 5-mo, very active 40 lb puppy. Estimate intake ~3.5 cups/day for a high-activity, heavier-than-average pug puppy. Kibble rule-of-thumb: 1 cup ≈ 4 oz = 0.25 lb → 3.5 cups ≈ 0.875 lb/day. Monthly (30d) = 0.875 * 30 = 26.25 lb/month. A 14-lb bag provides ≈ 56 cups (14 lb ÷ 0.25 lb per cup) but in weight terms lasts 14 ÷ 26.25 ≈ 0.53 months (~16 days). Given predictable, daily depletion and AJ's growth, this should be on autoship so you never run out.
subscription_products.personalized_note: AJ is growing fast and very active — this Royal Canin small/puppy formula (Mars family) is a breed/size-friendly choice that helps support his developing joints and energy needs. I’m recommending a fairly short autoship cadence because at 40 lb and high activity he burns through puppy kibble quickly; you can lengthen interval as he matures and his feeding amount stabilizes.

subscription_products.product_name: Pupford Chicken Soft & Chewy Training Dog Treats, 5-oz pouch
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Training treats are high-frequency consumables for a 5‑month-old puppy. If AJ receives ~15 small training treats/day during sessions (short, frequent reinforcement), that’s 15 × 30 = 450 treats/month. Typical small training treat weight ≈ 1.5 g → monthly ≈ 675 g ≈ 23.8 oz. A 5-oz pouch (~142 g) would therefore be used in ~6 days. Autoship keeps treats available for daily training without excess trips.
subscription_products.personalized_note: AJ is at prime training age — small, single-ingredient chicken treats are perfect for fast reinforcement without upsetting his calories. Because AJ is allergic to duck, this chicken Pupford pouch is a safe, high-value training option.

subscription_products.product_name: Blue Dog Bakery Perfect Trainers Beef Soft & Chewy Dog Treats, 6-oz bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Variety in training treats extends interest and keeps AJ engaged. If you swap in this 6-oz bag for some sessions (estimate replacing ~8–10 oz/week of treats), expect a 6-oz bag to last ~2–3 weeks depending on daily training intensity.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Rotate a small beef training treat into AJ’s sessions for novelty during learning — he’s energetic and will respond well to a variety of small, tasty rewards. Avoid duck-based varieties because of AJ’s allergy.

subscription_products.product_name: Pupford Beef Limited-Ingredient-Diet Adult Soft & Chewy Training Dog Treats, 5-oz bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Limited-ingredient treats are useful to rotate in to avoid allergic triggers and to keep calories in check. Using similar math as above (moderate daily training) a 5-oz bag will be depleted in about a week — autoship keeps a steady supply during intensive early training.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Because AJ has a food allergy to duck, a limited-ingredient beef option gives you a safe, repeatable reward during training—great for teaching impulse control during high‑energy bouts.

subscription_products.product_name: Buddy Biscuits Trainers Training Bites Chicken Flavor Dog Treats, 10-oz bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Larger 10-oz training bags are efficient for frequent practice. Using ~15 treats/day (roughly 24 oz/month), a 10‑oz bag will last ~12–13 days. Adding this as a second autoship treat source smooths replenishment and gives you a lower-calorie option for higher-volume reinforcement.
subscription_products.personalized_note: AJ will likely earn a LOT of treats while learning — this 10‑oz bag is a wallet-friendly backup so you don’t run out mid-week of training sessions in the apartment or yard.

subscription_products.product_name: Lil' Bitz Flame Roasted Chicken Grain-Free Training Dog Treats, 4-oz bag, bundle of 2
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Bundle packs are handy for variety and saving on frequent-used training treats. If AJ uses ~24 oz/month of treats, a 2×4-oz bundle (8 oz total) lasts ~10 days of heavy training. Autoship every 1–2 weeks avoids gaps.
subscription_products.personalized_note: This bundle gives you a grain-free, small-bite option to vary AJ’s rewards — great for keeping his interest during training games in the apartment.

subscription_products.product_name: Squishface Wrinkle Wipes Dog Grooming Wipes, 80 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Wrinkle/fold cleaning is a recurring preventive need for brachycephalic pugs. If you wipe AJ’s facial folds ~3×/week and use ≈2 wipes/session: 3 × 4 × 4 weeks = ~24 wipes/month. An 80-count tub lasts ≈3 months. Autoship set to quarterly keeps you stocked without overbuying.
subscription_products.personalized_note: AJ’s facial folds need regular attention — these wrinkle wipes make that quick and safe. Start with monthly checks; at this cadence the 80-count container will last several months, so I recommend quarterly autoship.

subscription_products.product_name: Natural Dog Company Wrinkle Balm Dog Grooming Wipes, 100 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Alternate wrinkle wipe format (100-count) for variety and to match different sensitivities. Using same fold-cleaning math (≈24 wipes/month) this 100-count tub will last ≈4 months — a quarterly subscription can be useful as backup.
subscription_products.personalized_note: A second wrinkle-wipe option keeps your routine flexible if AJ’s skin is sensitive. These are gentle and great to have on automatic during warm months when fold irritation risk rises.

subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Paw wipes are used every walk for apartment cleanliness and paw care. If AJ goes on 2 walks/day and you use ~1 wipe per walk that’s 60 wipes/month. A 70-count pack will be depleted in ≈30–35 days. Autoship monthly prevents running out during wet/dirty seasons.
subscription_products.personalized_note: AJ’s apartment life + frequent outdoor time means muddy or pollen-y paws. Monthly autoship keeps fresh paw wipes available so you can clean his pads right after walks and protect against irritation.

subscription_products.product_name: Natural Dog Company Paw Dog Grooming Wipes, 50 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Smaller paw-wipe packs are handy for travel or weekend outings. If weekend trips increase use, a 50-count pack might be used every 3–4 weeks. Autoship every month gives you a travel-ready supply.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Keep a travel pack of paw wipes on rotation for AJ when you take him to the yard or on errands — they’re compact and useful for quick clean-ups after play.

subscription_products.product_name: Dandylion Clean Paws Mini Dog Paw Cleaner, 2.7-fl oz bottle
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Liquid paw cleaners are consumable (refills or replacement bottles). If used after many walks, expect to go through a small bottle every 1–2 months depending on dilution/use. Autoship every 2 months keeps one on hand.
subscription_products.personalized_note: This little paw cleaner is great to keep by the door for quick rinses — handy for AJ after muddy yard time or rainy walks. A slow cadence is fine unless AJ is out a lot.

subscription_products.product_name: The Blissful Dog Fresh Flat Face Wash for Dogs, 8-fl oz bottle
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: A topical face wash used periodically for folds; if you wash AJ’s face 1–2×/week, an 8‑oz bottle will last ~2–3 months. Set autoship to every 2–3 months for routine preventive care.
subscription_products.personalized_note: This flat-face wash is formulated for brachycephalic breeds — it’s a gentle way to keep AJ’s folds clean and reduce infection risk.

subscription_products.product_name: Ethical Pet Play Strong Rubber S-shaped Tough Dog Chew Toy, 12-in
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: AJ is a very strong chewer. Durable rubber chews still wear out over time. Estimate durable chew replacement ~every 8–12 weeks for an aggressive chewer. An autoship can provide a fresh tough chew on a 2–3 month cadence to prevent him destroying unsafe household items.
subscription_products.personalized_note: AJ’s strong chewing means you’ll need replacement tough chews more often than for gentler dogs. An automatic delivery every few months gives you a safe, heavy-duty chew ready when the old one starts failing.

subscription_products.product_name: Pet Parents Pet WiPees All Purpose Allergy Dog Wipes, Calming Scent, 100 count
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: All-purpose/body wipes are used frequently for paw/fold/coat cleanups and are helpful for allergy control. If you use ~10 wipes/week for face/paws and quick clean-ups → ~40 wipes/month; a 100-count pack lasts ~2.5 months. Autoship every 2–3 months keeps supply steady.
subscription_products.personalized_note: These all-purpose wipes are a great catch-all for AJ’s daily messes and are gentle on sensitive skin — handy for an apartment dog who goes out often.

one_time_products.product_name: Puppia Polyester Back Clip Dog Harness, Black, Small
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A padded, well-fitting harness is a durable, multi-month safety item that protects AJ’s trachea (critical for brachycephalic pugs). This is a core setup item for Month 1 crate/house training and outdoor walks.
one_time_products.personalized_note: AJ’s short nose and sensitive airway mean a harness is a must — this Puppia back-clip will help keep pressure off his neck on every walk around the apartment and in the yard.

one_time_products.product_name: allforpaws Chill Out Papaya Cooling Mat Dog Bed, Blue
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Cooling mats are seasonal/urgent safety items for brachycephalic breeds during heat warnings. This is a one-time purchase (durable) used as-needed during warm months.
one_time_products.personalized_note: AJ overheats easily as a pug — grab a cooling mat now to give him a safe, immediate place to lower his body temp after play in the yard or active indoor sessions.

one_time_products.product_name: FUKUMARU Stainless Steel Dog Water Fountain, 1.8-gal
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A water fountain is a durable, multi-year investment that ensures continuous access to fresh water — especially important for heat-sensitive pugs. This is a setup essential, not a consumable.
one_time_products.personalized_note: AJ will benefit from always-available cool, circulating water in the apartment. This fountain reduces the risk of heat-related issues and encourages hydration during active play.

one_time_products.product_name: PetSafe Busy Buddy Tug-A-Jug Treat Dispenser Tough Dog Chew Toy, Medium/Large
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Heavy-duty treat-dispensing toys are durable tools for teething and destructive behavior prevention; buy once and monitor wear. They are not high-frequency consumables.
one_time_products.personalized_note: AJ is a strong chewer and teether — a tough treat dispenser like this keeps him busy, offers enrichment, and protects your furniture while he’s learning what’s OK to chew.

one_time_products.product_name: PuzzleFeeder Slow Feeder Puzzle Dog Toy, Large, Yellow
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Slow feeders and puzzles are durable enrichment items that reduce gulping and obesity risk — a one-time purchase that pays off over months/years.
one_time_products.personalized_note: AJ gulps easily and pugs are prone to obesity — this slow feeder will help him eat more slowly and comfortably, protecting his digestion and weight as he grows.

one_time_products.product_name: Awoo Meadow Snuffle Mat Silicone Dog & Cat Lick Mat Slow Feeder, Mauve
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Snuffle mats are long-lasting enrichment tools that slow feeding and encourage foraging — buy once and rotate into play/feeding, not a recurring consumable.
one_time_products.personalized_note: AJ will enjoy sniff games — this snuffle mat is perfect for indoor enrichment on hot or rainy days and helps slow his eating, which is great for his breed.

one_time_products.product_name: Squishy Face Studio Flirt Pole V2 with Lure Dog Toy, Purple & Blue Tie Dye, Junior
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Flirt poles are owner-led exercise tools (durable). They’re a one-time buy for high-intensity, short-burst exercise, useful for burning AJ’s energy indoors.
one_time_products.personalized_note: AJ’s high energy means you’ll want a reliable indoor energy-burner. A flirt pole gives you quick, intense sessions that tire him out without long outdoor runs.

one_time_products.product_name: Bedsure Ultra Soft Fleece Thin Washable Dog Crate Mat, Brown, Medium: 29-in L x 18-in W
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Crate mats and beds are durable, multi-month setup items to create a safe, comfortable den for crate training — buy once and use through puppyhood.
one_time_products.personalized_note: A cozy crate mat will help AJ settle and crate-train more comfortably in the apartment — pick a washable style so you can keep it fresh as he grows.

one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A treat pouch is a durable training accessory (multi-year). It’s a one-off buy that makes training sessions easier and tidier.
one_time_products.personalized_note: AJ’s energy and training needs make a treat pouch invaluable — it keeps treats handy during short sessions in the apartment and when practicing recall in the yard.

one_time_products.product_name: Casfuy Quiet 2 LED Medium & Large Dog & Cat Nail Grinder, Dark Blue
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A nail grinder is a durable tool for at-home nail maintenance — purchase once and use for many months to years; not a repeat consumable.
one_time_products.personalized_note: For apartment life, keeping AJ’s nails short makes walking and comfort better. This quieter grinder is gentle for puppies and will serve you for years.

one_time_products.product_name: Frisco Non-Skid Slow Feeder Dog & Small Pet Bowl, Black, Medium: 4 cup
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A slow-feeder bowl is a durable feeding tool that reduces gulping and bloat risk — buy once and continue using as AJ grows.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Because AJ gulps and pugs have reflux/bloat risk, a slow feeder is an important one-time purchase to protect his digestion and slow mealtime.

one_time_products.product_name: GoughNuts K9 Kup Dog Toy, 5-in, Red/Black
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: GoughNuts are top-tier, extremely durable chew toys for power chewers — a safety-first one-time buy to reduce risk of ingestion from destroyed toys.
one_time_products.personalized_note: AJ is a strong chewer — investing in an ultra-durable GoughNuts toy reduces the chance he breaks and ingests pieces of softer toys. It’s a high-value, safety-forward choice.

one_time_products.product_name: Leash Boss Traffic Handle Short Dog Leash, 12-in
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: A short traffic handle leash is a durable safety tool for apartment exits and crowded areas — single purchase, long life.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Keep AJ close while navigating the apartment building or busy sidewalks — a short traffic handle leash gives you secure control for training and safety.

one_time_products.product_name: Mighty Paw LED Dog Collar, Orange, Small
one_time_products.one_time_rationale: LED collars/visibility gear are durable seasonal safety buys — purchase once and store/charge as needed for low-light walks.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Early-morning or evening walks (and noisy seasons that push outings earlier/later) make a light-up collar a smart one-time safety buy so AJ is visible near roads and in the yard.

one_time_products.one_time_rationale: Toy storage is a one-time organizational purchase to support rotation and keep the apartment tidy; durable and not consumable.
one_time_products.personalized_note: Rotating AJ’s toys reduces boredom and protects fragile items — a storage basket will help you keep the apartment clean and manage his rotation safely.

overall_strategy: Month 1 (new puppy) focuses on essentials and preventing urgent risks for AJ: continuous nutrition, training treats, and fold/paw care are the highest recurring needs and should be on autoship. I prioritized a Royal Canin puppy formula (Mars family) sized for predictable, heavy monthly consumption and multiple small-bag training-treat autoships to support intense early training. Important one-time buys (harness, cooling mat, water fountain, durable chew toys, slow feeder, enrichment tools) create a safe, comfortable home and reduce immediate health/behavior risks for a brachycephalic, strong‑chewing, high‑energy 5‑month-old living in an apartment with yard access. Autoship cadences are calculated from AJ’s weight/activity (shown in each rationale) so you get regular replenishment without waste; durable items are recommended once now and will pay dividends during training and growth.
